# FLX-3621: a consumer query or view uses an expression the engine does not allow

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Every node of the parsed text must be on a closed list of expression classes: column references, literals, comparisons, boolean logic, arithmetic, CASE, CAST to a closed list of types, IN, BETWEEN, LIKE, ILIKE, IS, joins with ON, subqueries, WITH that is not recursive, set operations, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, OFFSET, DISTINCT, and windows with PARTITION BY and ORDER BY. A node outside the list, or a modifier of an allowed node that the list does not name (a frame, USING, NATURAL, a star modifier, WITH RECURSIVE), is refused. The message names the node. Rewrite the question with the allowed forms.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3621
```
